'''Verenar''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who was sent by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] to represent them at the [[Cularin Trade Show]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He exhibited the companies [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A blaster rifle]] and boasted about its enhanced damage capability. He was very proud to work for BlasTech.
